name: PM YASASVI – Top Class Education in Schools (Classes 11–12)
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
summary: Central support for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students in notified Top Class Schools; Class 11–12 students should verify the school list and available slots.
benefits: Up to ₹1,25,000 per year for Classes 11–12 under the scheme guidelines; eligible fee components and limits apply.

eligibility.incomeLimit: Family income ceiling and school/slot conditions apply; check current guidelines.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP when the relevant fresh/renewal window is open.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows application till 30 November 2026. Confirm fresh/renewal eligibility and state/class slots on NSP.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India
summary: Post-matric financial support for eligible students with benchmark disabilities continuing education after Class 10. Course, disability and income rules apply.
benefits: The department lists tuition/admission support, maintenance allowance, and book/disability allowances. Check current guidelines for the applicable fee ceiling and rates.

eligibility.identity: Valid UDID/disability certificate and current NSP conditions apply.

applicationProcess: Submit through NSP when applications are open and follow institute verification.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows student applications till 30 November 2026; check scheme specifications for exact rates.

name: Education Assistance to Wards of Beedi, Cine and Mine Workers – Post-Matric
provider: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
summary: Education assistance for eligible students whose parent is an eligible beedi, cine or specified mine worker. Worker-service, income and academic conditions apply.
benefits: The Ministry reported assistance up to ₹25,000 per student per year across eligible school, college and professional courses. Course-wise rates depend on current scheme rules.

eligibility.parentEmployment: Parent must meet the eligible worker and service conditions.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified cycle.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 post-matric application window as closed on 31 October 2026. The Ministry's 2025 release describes assistance up to ₹25,000/year; check the next cycle and course-wise rules.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS – Class 11–12
provider: HDFC Bank Parivartan (programme administrator details on official site)
summary: Financial support for Class 11–12 students facing financial difficulty or a personal/family crisis that puts continuation of education at risk.
benefits: ₹18,000 for eligible students in Classes 7–12 under the 2026–27 programme.

eligibility.preference: Preference for applicants facing a personal/family crisis in the previous three years.

applicationProcess: Use the official ECSS programme application route when the current cycle is accepting applications.
statusNote: Official programme page lists the 2026–27 cycle and a deadline of 15 December 2026. Confirm class-specific conditions and details before applying.

name: Telangana ePASS – Post-Matric Scholarship (Intermediate)
summary: Telangana ePASS includes Intermediate and vocational Intermediate courses under its post-matric course groups. Scheme eligibility, category rules, income limits and current application dates depend on the applicable notification.
benefits: Fee reimbursement and/or maintenance support may apply under the relevant Telangana post-matric scheme. No single amount is stated because it varies by category and course.

eligibility.courses: Intermediate and eligible vocational Intermediate courses (Group IV)
eligibility.other: Community, income, attendance and institution conditions vary by scheme.

requiredDocuments: Telangana residence/community and income records as applicable
applicationProcess: Use the official Telangana ePASS portal and select the relevant post-matric scheme. Confirm the college/course is approved and the current application window is active.
statusNote: The official course list explicitly includes Intermediate and vocational Intermediate (Group IV). Current 2026–27 application dates and category-specific benefits must be confirmed on ePASS.

name: Tata Trusts – Means Grant Programme
summary: Partial, need-based financial assistance for Indian residents studying in recognised schools or colleges. The grant is reimbursement-based and supports school students from Standard VIII onwards through graduation.
benefits: Partial financial assistance for eligible education expenses on a reimbursement basis; award amount depends on the application and programme assessment.

eligibility.institution: Recognised school or college in India.
eligibility.academic: At least pass class in the previous academic year; check the current 2026–27 guideline for exclusions.
eligibility.reimbursement: Fees should have been paid and fee receipts should be available.

requiredDocuments: Other documents listed in the current Tata Trusts guidelines
applicationProcess: Read the current Means Grant guidelines and submit the completed application with supporting documents using the official Tata Trusts instructions. ScholarSphere does not collect applications or documents.
statusNote: The official 2026–27 guideline says applications may be submitted before 31 March 2027; the programme page states applications are being accepted online by email. Check the current instructions before sending anything.

name: SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship – Classes 11–12
provider: SBI Foundation (CSR arm of State Bank of India)
summary: A national scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker backgrounds studying in Classes 9–12. Selection considers academic performance and family income; 50% of slots are reserved for female students.
benefits: ₹15,000 for the school-student category for the 2026–27 cycle, subject to selection and programme conditions.

eligibility.marks: 75% or 7.5 CGPA in the previous academic year; relaxations apply to specified categories.

requiredDocuments: Category or disability certificate if applicable
applicationProcess: The 2026–27 application cycle is closed. Check the official SBI Asha portal for result updates and the next application cycle.
statusNote: The official programme portal says applications closed on 19 September 2026. School-category shortlisting/results were still awaited on the official site at the time checked.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Classes 11–12)
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment / State and UT Governments
summary: Centrally sponsored post-matric support for eligible Scheduled Caste students after Class 10. The scheme is implemented by the student's domicile State/UT and can cover recognised post-matric courses, including eligible higher-secondary study.
benefits: Eligible compulsory fees and maintenance support are governed by the scheme guidelines and State/UT implementation. The amount depends on course group and applicable rules.

eligibility.income: Annual parental income ceiling generally ₹2.5 lakh under the central guidelines
eligibility.domicile: Apply through the State/UT of domicile

requiredDocuments: Bank and identity details requested by the State/UT portal
applicationProcess: Apply through the domicile State/UT scholarship portal or the National Scholarship Portal when the relevant application window is open.
statusNote: The scheme is open-ended and demand-driven, but application windows and processing are State/UT managed. Check the current state notification.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Classes 11–12)
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / State and UT Governments
summary: Centrally sponsored support for eligible Scheduled Tribe students studying after Class 10, including Class 11 and 12. States/UTs invite applications, verify eligibility and disburse awards.
benefits: Compulsory fees subject to State limits plus a course-based maintenance allowance; exact rates depend on the course group and current guidelines.

eligibility.domicile: Apply through the State/UT of domicile

requiredDocuments: Bank and identity details requested by the State/UT portal
applicationProcess: Apply through the domicile State/UT scholarship portal or NSP when applications are invited. Confirm course eligibility and current dates with the State/UT.
statusNote: The Ministry confirms this scheme for Class XI and above. States/UTs manage the application and disbursement process; check the current state window.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students (Classes 11–12)

eligibility.communities: Notified minority communities under the applicable scheme
